thought.text: API setup complete. Now create the API token via tinker, and check the API responds.

reasoning_content:
API setup done. Now generate the token via tinker. Then set up web_application.

Let me create the token non-interactively.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T tooling bash -lc 'cd api && php artisan tinker --execute="echo \App\Models\User::find(1)->createToken(\"Super Admin Token\")->plainTextToken;"' 2>&1 | grep -v "level=warning" | tail -5
